## Module 16. 结果导出与总结报告

导出所有关键结果为通用格式，便于下游分析和共享。

```{r export_results}
dir.create(igv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if(!exists("res_df") || !is.data.frame(res_df)) {
  res_df <- read_step_table("Step5", "Differential_Peaks.csv")
}
if(!exists("all_res_df") || !is.data.frame(all_res_df)) {
  all_res_df <- read_step_table("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_AllSites.csv")
}
if(nrow(res_df) > 0) res_df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(res_df)
if(nrow(all_res_df) > 0) all_res_df <- standardize_diff_peak_df(all_res_df)

# --- 13.1 导出差异 Peaks 为 BED 格式 ---
if((exists("dba_res") && length(dba_res) > 0) || (exists("res_df") && nrow(res_df) > 0)) {
  # 转换为 data.frame
  diff_peaks_df <- if(exists("dba_res") && length(dba_res) > 0) {
    as.data.frame(dba_res)
  } else {
    res_df
  }
  diff_peaks_df <- filter_diff_peaks(diff_peaks_df, mode = "primary")
  diff_peaks_df$seqnames <- ensure_ucsc_seqnames(diff_peaks_df$seqnames)
  
  # 导出为 BED 格式 (chr, start, end, name, score, strand)
  bed_cols <- c("seqnames", "start", "end")
  bed_df <- diff_peaks_df[, bed_cols]
  # DiffBind/GRanges is 1-based inclusive; BED is 0-based half-open.
  bed_df$start <- pmax(0L, bed_df$start - 1L)
  bed_df$name <- paste0("Peak_", seq_len(nrow(bed_df)))
  bed_df$score <- round(abs(diff_peaks_df$Fold) * 100)  # 用 Fold Change 作为 score
  bed_df$strand <- "."
  
  # 添加方向信息
  bed_df$name <- ifelse(diff_peaks_df$Fold > 0,
                        paste0(bed_df$name, "_", treatment_group, "_open"),
                        paste0(bed_df$name, "_", baseline_group, "_open"))
  
  write.table(bed_df, step_table_file("Step16", "Differential_Peaks.bed"), 
              sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
  write.table(bed_df, file.path(igv_dir, "Differential_Peaks.bed"),
              sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
  cat("导出差异 Peaks BED 文件:", nrow(bed_df), "peaks\n")

  # 额外导出方向性 BED，替代旧的 generate_igv_files.R
  up_bed <- bed_df[diff_peaks_df$Fold > 0, ]
  down_bed <- bed_df[diff_peaks_df$Fold < 0, ]
  write.table(up_bed, file.path(igv_dir, paste0("Differential_Peaks_", treatment_group, "_open.bed")),
              sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
  write.table(down_bed, file.path(igv_dir, paste0("Differential_Peaks_", baseline_group, "_open.bed")),
              sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
  
  # --- 13.2 导出样本 BigWig 路径列表 (用于 IGV) ---
  bw_files <- data.frame(
    Sample = samples,
    Condition = conditions,
    BigWig = bigwig_files,
    BigWigNormalization = "RPGC",
    BigWigNamingStatus = bigwig_method_status$NamingStatus,
    BAM = bam_files,
    Peaks = peak_files
  )
  write.csv(bw_files, step_table_file("Step16", "Sample_Track_Manifest.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(bw_files, file.path(igv_dir, "Sample_Track_Manifest.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
  cat("导出样本轨迹清单\n")

  overlap_tbl <- if(file.exists(step_table_file("Step9", "Overlapping_Genes.csv"))) {
    read.csv(step_table_file("Step9", "Overlapping_Genes.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  multiomics_tbl <- if(file.exists(step_table_file("Step9", "Multiomics_Gene_Priority_Table.csv"))) {
    read.csv(step_table_file("Step9", "Multiomics_Gene_Priority_Table.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  pathway_tbl <- if(file.exists(step_table_file("Step9", "ATAC_RNA_GSEA_Pathway_Concordance.csv"))) {
    read.csv(step_table_file("Step9", "ATAC_RNA_GSEA_Pathway_Concordance.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
	  regulation_tbl <- if(file.exists(step_table_file("Step9", "Regulation_Category_Analysis.csv"))) {
	    read.csv(step_table_file("Step9", "Regulation_Category_Analysis.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
	  } else {
	    data.frame()
	  }
  # --- 13.3 导出最值得展示的 ATAC-RNA overlap genes ---
  if(nrow(overlap_tbl) > 0) {
    top_overlap_genes <- overlap_tbl %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
      slice_head(n = 25)
    write.csv(top_overlap_genes,
              step_table_file("Step16", "Top_ATAC_RNA_Overlap_Genes.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  # --- 13.4 生成整合分析摘要报告 ---
  summary_report <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "分析日期",
      "样本数量",
      "Reference 样本数",
      "Comparison 样本数",
      "平均 read-level FRiP（alignment overlap）",
      "平均 Clean Peak 数",
      paste0("正式差异 Peak 总数 (", primary_diff_peak_label(), ")"),
      "Comparison 上调 Peaks",
      "Reference 上调 Peaks",
      "Footprint 高优先 TF 数",
      "多组学高优先基因数 (score>=6)",
      "ATAC支持RNA GSEA通路数",
      "ATAC-RNA 重叠基因数",
      "Activated 基因数",
      "Repressed 基因数"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(Sys.Date()),
      length(samples),
      sum(conditions == "Reference"),
      sum(conditions == "Comparison"),
      ifelse(exists("frip_data"), round(mean(frip_data$FRiP), 3), "N/A"),
      ifelse(exists("peak_counts"), round(mean(peak_counts$CleanPeaks)), "N/A"),
      ifelse(exists("res_df"), nrow(res_df), "N/A"),
      ifelse(exists("res_df"), sum(res_df$Fold > 0), "N/A"),
      ifelse(exists("res_df"), sum(res_df$Fold < 0), "N/A"),
      ifelse(exists("footprint_regulator_tbl"), sum(footprint_regulator_tbl$direction != "NS", na.rm = TRUE), "N/A"),
      ifelse(nrow(multiomics_tbl) > 0, sum(multiomics_tbl$IntegratedPriorityScore >= 6, na.rm = TRUE), "N/A"),
      ifelse(nrow(pathway_tbl) > 0, nrow(pathway_tbl), "N/A"),
      ifelse(nrow(overlap_tbl) > 0, nrow(overlap_tbl), "N/A"),
      ifelse(nrow(regulation_tbl) > 0, sum(regulation_tbl$regulation_category == "Activated", na.rm = TRUE), "N/A"),
      ifelse(nrow(regulation_tbl) > 0, sum(regulation_tbl$regulation_category == "Repressed", na.rm = TRUE), "N/A")
    )
  )
  
  write.csv(summary_report, step_table_file("Step16", "Analysis_Summary_Report.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
  print(summary_report)
  cat("\n分析摘要报告已生成\n")

  # --- 13.5 输出简明汇报要点 ---
  key_lines <- c(
    paste0("分析日期: ", Sys.Date()),
    paste0("平均 FRiP: ", ifelse(exists("frip_data"), round(mean(frip_data$FRiP), 3), "NA")),
    paste0("Official differential peaks (", primary_diff_peak_label(), "): ", ifelse(exists("res_df"), nrow(res_df), "NA")),
    "Primary result set uses the selected significance mode; interpret results with the matching p-value/FDR layer and orthogonal evidence.",
    paste0("Footprint regulators (direction != NS): ", ifelse(exists("footprint_regulator_tbl"), sum(footprint_regulator_tbl$direction != "NS", na.rm = TRUE), "NA")),
    paste0("Multi-omics priority genes (score>=6): ", ifelse(nrow(multiomics_tbl) > 0, sum(multiomics_tbl$IntegratedPriorityScore >= 6, na.rm = TRUE), "NA")),
    paste0("ATAC-supported RNA GSEA pathways: ", ifelse(nrow(pathway_tbl) > 0, nrow(pathway_tbl), "NA")),
    paste0("ATAC-RNA overlap genes: ", ifelse(nrow(overlap_tbl) > 0, nrow(overlap_tbl), "NA")),
    paste0("Activated genes: ", ifelse(nrow(regulation_tbl) > 0, sum(regulation_tbl$regulation_category == "Activated", na.rm = TRUE), "NA")),
    paste0("ATAC_up_RNA_down genes: ", ifelse(nrow(regulation_tbl) > 0, sum(regulation_tbl$regulation_category == "ATAC_up_RNA_down", na.rm = TRUE), "NA"))
  )
  writeLines(key_lines, con = step_table_file("Step16", "Presentation_Key_Messages.txt"))
  writeLines(c("# ATAC-seq presentation summary", "", paste0("- ", key_lines)),
             con = step_table_file("Step16", "Enhanced_Analysis_Summary.md"))
}

# --- 13.7 结果清单将在文档末尾统一生成 ---
cat("结果清单会在文档末尾统一刷新，确保后续 module 产物也被纳入 Result_Manifest。\n")
```

```{r final_delivery_refresh}
tf_concordance_tbl <- if(exists("tf_target_concordance")) tf_target_concordance else read_step_table("Step10", "TF_Gene_Concordance_Summary.csv")
gene_matrix_tbl <- if(exists("gene_evidence_matrix")) gene_evidence_matrix else read_step_table("Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.csv")
wgbs_support_tbl <- if(exists("wgbs_gene_centric_support")) wgbs_gene_centric_support else read_step_table("Step11", "wgbs_gene_centric_support.csv")
wgbs_candidates_tbl <- if(exists("wgbs_candidates")) wgbs_candidates else read_step_table("Step11", "atac_wgbs_gene_centric_candidates.csv")
if(nrow(wgbs_candidates_tbl) == 0 && nrow(wgbs_support_tbl) > 0) {
  wgbs_candidates_tbl <- wgbs_support_tbl
}
gene_centric_tbl_step8 <- read_step_table("Step9", "ATAC_RNA_Gene_Centric_Wide.csv")
representative_loci_tbl <- read_step_table("Step15", "Representative_Loci.csv")

final_summary_report <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "分析日期",
    "run_profile",
    "样本数量",
    paste0("正式差异 Peak 总数 (", primary_diff_peak_label(), ")"),
    "Direction-stratified peaks with annotation",
    "ATAC-RNA gene-centric genes",
    "TF-gene concordance TF 数",
    "Gene-centric evidence matrix 基因数",
    "EvidenceLayerCount >= 4 基因数",
    "WGBS-supported gene-centric candidates",
    "Representative loci",
    "Locus reports"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(Sys.Date()),
    run_profile,
    length(samples),
    ifelse(exists("res_df"), nrow(res_df), NA),
    nrow(read_step_table("Step5", "Directional_Chromatin_Context.csv")),
    ifelse(nrow(gene_centric_tbl_step8) > 0, nrow(gene_centric_tbl_step8), 0),
    ifelse(nrow(tf_concordance_tbl) > 0, nrow(tf_concordance_tbl), 0),
    ifelse(nrow(gene_matrix_tbl) > 0, nrow(gene_matrix_tbl), 0),
    ifelse(nrow(gene_matrix_tbl) > 0, sum(gene_matrix_tbl$EvidenceLayerCount >= 4, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    ifelse(nrow(wgbs_candidates_tbl) > 0, nrow(wgbs_candidates_tbl), 0),
    ifelse(nrow(representative_loci_tbl) > 0, nrow(representative_loci_tbl), 0),
    ifelse(file.exists(step_table_file("Step15", "Locus_Report_Manifest.csv")),
           nrow(read_step_table("Step15", "Locus_Report_Manifest.csv")), 0)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
save_step_table(final_summary_report, "Step16", "Analysis_Summary_Report.csv")

if(nrow(gene_matrix_tbl) > 0) {
  top_gene_matrix_tbl <- gene_matrix_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(geneSymbol) & geneSymbol != "") %>%
    arrange(desc(GeneCentricPriorityScore), desc(EvidenceLayerCount), RNA_pvalue, BestATACPvalue) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30)
  save_step_table(top_gene_matrix_tbl, "Step16", "Top_Gene_Centric_Candidates.csv")
}

final_key_lines <- c(
  paste0("Run profile: ", run_profile),
  paste0("Differential peaks (", primary_diff_peak_label(), "): ", ifelse(exists("res_df"), nrow(res_df), "NA")),
  "Primary result set uses the selected significance mode; interpret results with the matching p-value/FDR layer and orthogonal evidence.",
  paste0("Direction-stratified annotated peaks: ", nrow(read_step_table("Step5", "Directional_Chromatin_Context.csv"))),
  paste0("ATAC-RNA gene-centric genes: ", ifelse(nrow(gene_centric_tbl_step8) > 0, nrow(gene_centric_tbl_step8), "NA")),
  paste0("Top TF-gene concordance TFs: ", ifelse(nrow(tf_concordance_tbl) > 0, nrow(tf_concordance_tbl), "NA")),
  paste0("Gene-centric evidence matrix genes: ", ifelse(nrow(gene_matrix_tbl) > 0, nrow(gene_matrix_tbl), "NA")),
  paste0("Genes with >=4 evidence layers: ", ifelse(nrow(gene_matrix_tbl) > 0, sum(gene_matrix_tbl$EvidenceLayerCount >= 4, na.rm = TRUE), "NA")),
  paste0("WGBS-supported candidates: ", ifelse(nrow(wgbs_candidates_tbl) > 0, nrow(wgbs_candidates_tbl), "NA")),
  paste0("Representative loci: ", ifelse(nrow(representative_loci_tbl) > 0, nrow(representative_loci_tbl), "NA"))
)
writeLines(final_key_lines, con = step_table_file("Step16", "Presentation_Key_Messages.txt"))
writeLines(c("# ATAC-seq final delivery summary", "", paste0("- ", final_key_lines)),
           con = step_table_file("Step16", "Enhanced_Analysis_Summary.md"))
```

```{r final_result_manifest}
key_upstream_delivery_files <- function() {
  files <- c(
    file.path(work_dir, "metadata", "sample_manifest.tsv"),
    file.path(work_dir, "04counts", c(
      "FRiP_scores.txt",
      "consensus_peaks_union.bed",

result_files <- c(
  list.files(plot_root_dir, pattern = "\\.pdf$|\\.png$|\\.svg$|\\.html$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE),
  list.files(table_root_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$|\\.tsv$|\\.txt$|\\.bed$|\\.rnk$|\\.md$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE),
  list.files(igv_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$|\\.bed$|\\.txt$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE),
  key_upstream_delivery_files()
)

result_files <- result_files[
  !grepl("/logs/", result_files, fixed = TRUE) &
    !grepl("/\\.cache/", result_files) &
    !grepl("/result/README\\.md$", result_files)
]

workflow_checklist <- data.frame(
  Layer = c(
    "metadata", "upstream", "upstream", "upstream", "upstream", "upstream",

    "one RPGC-normalized bigWig per sample",
    "04counts/FRiP_scores.txt",
    "06qc_report/TSS_Enrichment_Method.tsv and per-sample TSS matrices/profiles",

    "06qc_report/atac_multiqc_report.html",
    "result/03_atac_qc tables and plots",
    "result/05_differential_accessibility full, primary, p-value, and FDR tables",

  ),

  ),
  Status = c(

    ifelse(all(file.exists(bam_files)) && all(file.exists(paste0(bam_files, ".bai"))), "PASS", "MISSING"),
    ifelse(all(file.exists(peak_files)), "PASS", "MISSING"),
    ifelse(all(file.exists(bigwig_files)), "PASS", "MISSING"),
    ifelse(file.exists(file.path(work_dir, "04counts", "FRiP_scores.txt")), "PASS", "MISSING"),
    ifelse(file.exists(file.path(work_dir, "06qc_report", "TSS_Enrichment_Method.tsv")), "PASS", "MISSING"),

             file.exists(file.path(work_dir, "03peaks", "IDR_Reproducibility_Summary.tsv")), "PASS", "MISSING"),

    ifelse(nrow(read_step_table("Step5", "Differential_Peaks_AllSites.csv")) > 0, "PASS", "MISSING"),

      "PARTIAL_OR_MISSING"
    ),
    ifelse(nrow(read_step_table("Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.csv")) > 0, "PASS", "MISSING"),
    "PASS"
  ),
  Note = c(
    "sample names and group labels are sourced from reads_info/sample_manifest",
    "source data are preserved and not modified by downstream modules",
    "fastp outputs are present for all four samples",
    "BAM and BAI files are present for all samples",

    "Read-level FRiP counts deduplicated alignment overlaps; no fragment-level pass threshold is applied",
    "current TSS value is a deepTools-derived approximation, not an ENCODE TSSE replacement",
    "IDR is present for the two-condition two-replicate design",
    "MultiQC aggregates upstream tool summaries",
    "QC module preserves raw metric definitions and threshold assessment",
    "full, p-value, FDR and selected primary tables are all preserved",
    "motif/footprint evidence should be interpreted together, not as single-method proof",
    "integration depends on external RNA/WGBS result directories recorded in Module02",
    "key-gene evidence is gene-centric and should be read with supporting layers",
    "final delivery files are generated after manifest refresh"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

upstream_signature_file <- file.path(work_dir, "metadata", "upstream_config_signature.tsv")
upstream_signature_tbl <- if(file.exists(upstream_signature_file)) read.delim(upstream_signature_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else data.frame()
upstream_freshness_status <- if(nrow(upstream_signature_tbl) > 0 && all(c("Field", "Value") %in% colnames(upstream_signature_tbl))) {
  upstream_signature_tbl$Value[match("Status", upstream_signature_tbl$Field)]
} else {
  "MISSING_SIGNATURE"
}
if(is.na(upstream_freshness_status) || grepl("^STALE|MISSING", upstream_freshness_status)) {
  workflow_checklist$Status[workflow_checklist$Status == "PASS"] <- "STALE"
}
raw_clean_complete <- all(file.exists(sample_manifest$raw_r1_resolved)) &&
  all(file.exists(sample_manifest$raw_r2_resolved)) &&
  all(file.exists(file.path(work_dir, sample_manifest$clean_r1))) &&
  all(file.exists(file.path(work_dir, sample_manifest$clean_r2)))
if(!isTRUE(raw_clean_complete)) upstream_freshness_status <- "STALE_MISSING_RAW_OR_CLEAN_INPUTS"

module_problem_status <- function(path) {
  files <- list.files(file.path(path, "tables"), pattern = "(Status|Skipped_State)\\.(csv|tsv)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  files <- files[basename(files) != "Current_Result_Status.csv"]
  states <- unlist(lapply(files, function(file) {
    tbl <- tryCatch(if(grepl("\\.tsv$", file)) read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) data.frame())
    columns <- names(tbl)[tolower(names(tbl)) %in% c("status", "state")]
    toupper(as.character(unlist(tbl[columns], use.names = FALSE)))
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  if(any(grepl("FAIL|ERROR", states))) return("HAS_FAILURES")
  if(any(grepl("STALE|UNVERIFIED|RUNNING", states))) return("UNVERIFIED")
  if(any(grepl("SKIP|NOT_RUN|MISSING|INCOMPLETE", states))) return("PARTIAL_OR_SKIPPED")
  "OUTPUTS_PRESENT_UNVERIFIED"
}
module_status_tbl <- module_result_index %>%
  mutate(
    TableCount = vapply(Path, function(p) length(list.files(file.path(p, "tables"), pattern = "\\.(csv|tsv|txt|bed|rnk|md)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)), integer(1)),
    PdfPlotCount = vapply(Path, function(p) length(list.files(file.path(p, "plots"), pattern = "\\.pdf$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)), integer(1)),
    PngPreviewCount = vapply(Path, function(p) length(list.files(file.path(p, "plots"), pattern = "\\.png$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)), integer(1)),
    OtherPlotCount = vapply(Path, function(p) length(list.files(file.path(p, "plots"), pattern = "\\.(svg|html)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)), integer(1)),
    PlotCount = PdfPlotCount + PngPreviewCount + OtherPlotCount,
    SkippedStateCount = vapply(Path, function(p) length(list.files(file.path(p, "tables"), pattern = "_Skipped_State\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)), integer(1)),
    CalculationStatus = vapply(Path, module_problem_status, character(1)),
    UpstreamStatus = upstream_freshness_status,
    Status = dplyr::case_when(
      TableCount == 0 & PlotCount == 0 ~ "NO_OUTPUT",
      CalculationStatus == "HAS_FAILURES" ~ "HAS_FAILURES",
      CalculationStatus == "UNVERIFIED" ~ "UNVERIFIED",
      CalculationStatus == "PARTIAL_OR_SKIPPED" ~ "PARTIAL_OR_SKIPPED",
      is.na(UpstreamStatus) | UpstreamStatus != "CURRENT" ~ "STALE_OUTPUTS",
      TRUE ~ "OUTPUTS_PRESENT_UNVERIFIED"
    )
  )
save_step_table(module_status_tbl, "Step16", "Current_Result_Status.csv")

write_result_readme <- function() {
  final_summary_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Analysis_Summary_Report.csv")
  refs_tbl <- read_step_table("Step2", "Scientific_Standards_and_Repositories.csv")
  manifest_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Result_Manifest.csv")
  plot_audit_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Plot_Integrity_Audit.csv")
  preview_pair_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Plot_Preview_Pairing_Audit.csv")
  status_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Current_Result_Status.csv")
  workflow_tbl <- read_step_table("Step16", "Workflow_Completeness_Checklist.csv")

  rel_path <- function(path) {
    path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(work_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "/?"), "", path)
  }

  module_for_path <- function(path) {
    hits <- status_tbl$Directory[vapply(status_tbl$Directory, function(dir_name) grepl(paste0("/", dir_name, "/"), path, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))]
    if(length(hits) == 0) return("unknown")
    hits[1]
  }

  table_rows <- function(df) {
    if(is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(character())
    apply(df, 1, function(row) paste0("| ", paste(row, collapse = " | "), " |"))
  }

  md_table <- function(df, max_rows = nrow(df)) {
    if(is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(c("无。"))
    df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df <- df[seq_len(min(max_rows, nrow(df))), , drop = FALSE]
    c(
      paste0("| ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = " | "), " |"),
      paste0("| ", paste(rep("---", ncol(df)), collapse = " | "), " |"),
      table_rows(df)
    )
  }

  plot_reading_lines <- function(plot_row, idx) {
    file_name <- plot_row$File
    status <- plot_row$Status
    reason <- plot_row$Reason
    module_name <- module_for_path(plot_row$Path)
    plot_kind <- dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("FRiP", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "FRiP reads-in-peaks signal quality",
      grepl("Insert|NFR|Fragment", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ATAC fragment-size and nucleosome pattern",
      grepl("Peak|Annotation|DistToTSS|TSS|Chrom|Width|Depth|Element|UpSet", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "peak catalog and genomic-context review",
      grepl("PCA|Correlation", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "sample relationship and replicate/group structure",
      grepl("Volcano|Diff|Directional|Scatter|Heatmap", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "differential accessibility and direction-specific context",
      grepl("GO|KEGG|Enrichment", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "peak-associated gene enrichment",
      grepl("Motif|TF|Footprint|BINDetect", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TF motif or footprint evidence",
      grepl("RNA|Multiomics|Regulation|Gene", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "multi-omics gene-level support",
      grepl("WGBS|methyl|DMR", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ATAC-WGBS methylation support",
      grepl("GC|Conservation|PhastCons", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "sequence context, GC, or conservation review",
      grepl("locus|Locus", file_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "single-locus evidence report",
      TRUE ~ "module-specific visual output"
    )

    c(
      paste0("##### 图 ", idx, ". `", rel_path(plot_row$Path), "`"),
      "",
      "类型:",
      "",
      paste0("- figure / ", plot_row$Extension),
      "",
      "意义:",
      "",
      paste0("- 该文件属于 `", module_name, "`，用于支持 ", plot_kind, "。"),
      "",
      "解读方式:",
      "",
      paste0("- 先按文件名判断图的分析对象，再看坐标轴、分组颜色、图例、阈值线、facet 或热图色标；方向定义遵循 ", contrast_label, "，`Fold > 0` 表示 ", comparison_open_label, "。"),
      "",
      "本图实际意义:",
      "",
      paste0("- 这个图回答的是 `", plot_kind, "` 是否在当前样本和当前阈值下支持可复核的结果。"),
      "",
      "应该怎么看:",
      "",
      "- 若是柱图/箱线图，重点比较 Reference 与 Comparison 的高度或分布；若是散点/火山图，重点看阈值线两侧和方向；若是热图，重点看样本聚类、颜色梯度和分组一致性；若是 locus 图，重点看候选基因附近峰/轨迹是否与方向一致。",
      "",
      "图中关键元素:",
      "",
      "- 文件名、模块目录、分组颜色、阈值标注、坐标轴标题、图例、facet 分面、候选基因或 motif 标签是主要解读依据。",
      "",
      "本次图上看到什么:",
      "",
      paste0("- 自动审计状态为 `", status, "`，原因为 `", reason, "`；文件大小为 ", plot_row$SizeBytes, " bytes。本文未对每张图逐像素人工判读，具体视觉细节以打开对应 PDF/PNG 为准。"),
      "",
      "本图实际说明什么:",
      "",
      "- 该图作为当前模块的可视化证据存在并通过基础完整性审计；强生物学结论仍需同时查看同模块表格、阈值定义和跨模块支持。",
      ""
    )
  }

  summary_lines <- if(nrow(final_summary_tbl) > 0) {
    paste0("- ", final_summary_tbl$Metric, ": ", final_summary_tbl$Value)
  } else {
    "- Analysis_Summary_Report.csv 尚未生成。"
  }

  preview_summary_tbl <- if(nrow(preview_pair_tbl) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      Metric = c("PDF figure files", "Paired PNG preview files", "PDF files missing PNG", "Pairing audit PASS"),
      Value = c(
        nrow(preview_pair_tbl),
        sum(file.exists(preview_pair_tbl$PngPath)),
        sum(preview_pair_tbl$Status == "MISSING_PNG", na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(preview_pair_tbl$Status == "PASS", na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(Metric = "PDF/PNG preview pairing", Value = "no PDF figures found", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  strongest_lines <- c(
    "结果解释以各模块 CalculationStatus、UpstreamStatus 和来源校验为限；已有表图不能证明上游完整重现，STALE、失败或未验证的证据不得作为当前机制支持。",
    "按用户指定，本项目差异 peak 及本轮下游显著性筛选默认使用原始 p-value < 0.05，按名义显著解释，FDR 列仅供补充复核；多组学关联和 motif 候选不能单独建立调控因果，footprint 证据另须通过输入/输出来源验证。",
    "TSS enrichment 当前是 deepTools-derived approximation，已在 QC 表中标注，不能直接等同于 ENCODE TSSE。"
  )

  overview_tbl <- status_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      模块 = Directory,
      理论应有 = Note,
      本次实际产出 = if(all(c("PdfPlotCount", "PngPreviewCount", "OtherPlotCount") %in% colnames(status_tbl))) {
        paste0(TableCount, " tables; ", PdfPlotCount, " pdf; ", PngPreviewCount, " png; ", OtherPlotCount, " other plots")
      } else {
        paste0(TableCount, " tables; ", PlotCount, " plots")
      },
      缺失项 = ifelse(Status == "NO_OUTPUT", "no table/plot output detected", ifelse(SkippedStateCount > 0, paste0(SkippedStateCount, " skipped-state files"), "none obvious from file counts")),
      图像解读状态 = ifelse(PlotCount > 0, paste0(PlotCount, " files listed below"), "no figure output"),
      备注 = Status
    )

  lines <- c(
    "# ATAC-seq 结果读取与流程审计手册",
    "",
    "这份文档是结果读取手册和流程审计索引，不是脚本使用说明。审计范围包括 `01rawdata/`、`02mapping/`、`03peaks/`、`04counts/`、`05bigwig/`、`06qc_report/`、`07footprinting/`、`rmd/`、`result/` 和 `result/logs/`。",
    "",
    "本文所有结论只基于当前磁盘上真实存在的文件。图像类输出逐文件列出，并说明应该如何阅读、自动审计状态和解读限制。",
    "",
    "## 1. 如何使用这份文档",
    "",
    "- `理论应有` 指当前 Rmd/脚本设计应产生的图、表、manifest、track 或 skipped-state。",
    "- `本次实际产出` 指当前磁盘真实存在的文件数量和关键表格内容。",
    paste0("- ATAC 方向定义：`Fold > 0` 表示 ", comparison_open_label, "，`Fold < 0` 表示 ", reference_open_label, "；RNA 与 WGBS 方向沿用各自输入表定义。"),
    "- 每个模块建议按 `预期输出项 -> 实际发现 -> 缺失项与原因 -> 逐项解读` 阅读。",
    "- 缺失或 skipped-state 文件本身也应作为结果状态读取，不应被当作静默成功。",
    "",
    "## 2. 当前结果目录总览",
    "",
    "### 2.1 最终摘要",
    "",
    summary_lines,
    "",
    "### 2.2 模块级实际状态",
    "",
    md_table(overview_tbl),
    "",
    "### 2.3 流程完整性检查",
    "",
    md_table(workflow_tbl[, c("Layer", "Component", "Status", "Note"), drop = FALSE]),
    "",
    "### 2.4 PDF/PNG 图像配对检查",
    "",
    md_table(preview_summary_tbl),
    "",
    "### 2.5 外部标准与 GitHub 参考",
    "",
    md_table(refs_tbl[, intersect(c("Topic", "Source", "URL", "CurrentProjectStatus"), colnames(refs_tbl)), drop = FALSE]),
    "",
    "### 2.6 优先读取文件",
    "",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Analysis_Summary_Report.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Workflow_Completeness_Checklist.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Current_Result_Status.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Result_Manifest.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Plot_Integrity_Audit.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Plot_Preview_Pairing_Audit.csv`",
    "- `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Threshold_Definitions.csv`",
    "- `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Peaks_AllSites.csv`",
    "- `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Peaks.csv`",
    "- `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Peaks_FDR.csv`",
    "- `result/15_keygenes_locus_reports/tables/Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.csv`",
    "",
    "## 3. Major modules",
    ""
  )

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(status_tbl))) {
    info <- status_tbl[i, , drop = FALSE]
    module_plots <- plot_audit_tbl[vapply(plot_audit_tbl$Path, function(p) grepl(paste0("/", info$Directory, "/"), p, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)), , drop = FALSE]
    module_manifest <- manifest_tbl[vapply(manifest_tbl$Path, function(p) grepl(paste0("/", info$Directory, "/"), p, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)), , drop = FALSE]
    top_files <- head(rel_path(module_manifest$Path), 12)
    skip_files <- module_manifest[grepl("_Skipped_State\\.csv$", module_manifest$File), , drop = FALSE]

    lines <- c(
      lines,

      ""

    if(nrow(module_plots) == 0) {
      lines <- c(

        "类型:",

        "- figure",
        "",
        "意义:",
        "",
        "- 该模块当前没有 manifest 记录的图像类文件。",
        "",
        "解读方式:",
        "",
        "- 若预期应有图像，先查 `tables/*_Skipped_State.csv` 和 `result/logs/`。",
        "",
        "本次为什么没有生成:",
        "",
        "- 当前文件审计未发现图像输出；可能是该模块以表格为主、图像被 skipped，或缺少上游输入。",
        "",
        "本次暂无法解读的原因:",
        "",
        "- 缺少图像层证据，不能从视觉模式判断该模块结果。",
        ""
      )
    } else {
      for(j in seq_len(nrow(module_plots))) {
        lines <- c(lines, plot_reading_lines(module_plots[j, , drop = FALSE], j))
      }
    }
  }

  lines <- c(
    lines,
    "## Final synthesis",
    "",
    "### 当前最强结论",
    "",
    paste0("- ", strongest_lines),
    "",
    "### 当前 caution",
    "",
    "- 2 vs 2 bulk ATAC 设计对差异分析较敏感；p-value-only 结果适合探索，不应单独作为强机制结论。",
    "- TSS enrichment 当前方法与 ENCODE/ataqv TSSE 不完全等价，建议后续用 ataqv 或 ATACseqQC 复核。",
    "- motif、footprint、RNA、WGBS 和 locus report 应联合解读，单一证据层不能替代功能验证。",
    "",
    "### 推荐阅读顺序",
    "",
    "1. `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Analysis_Summary_Report.csv`",
    "2. `result/03_atac_qc/tables/QC_Threshold_Assessment.csv`",
    "3. `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Threshold_Definitions.csv`",
    "4. `result/05_differential_accessibility/tables/Differential_Peaks.csv` 及其 p-value/FDR 分层表",
    "5. `result/08_motif_activity/`、`result/10_footprinting_tf_evidence/`",
    "6. `result/09_rna_multiomics/`、`result/11_wgbs_integration/`、`result/15_keygenes_locus_reports/`",
    "",
    "### 关键保留文件",
    "",
    "- `01rawdata/reads_info.txt`",
    "- `metadata/sample_manifest.tsv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Result_Manifest.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Workflow_Completeness_Checklist.csv`",
    "- `result/16_export_summary_manifest/tables/Scientific_Standards_and_Repositories.csv` 若复制至最终交付包，请同时保留 Module02 原表",
    "- `result/logs/`"
  )

  writeLines(lines, con = file.path(work_dir, "README.md"))
  writeLines(lines, con = file.path(result_dir, "README.md"))
  invisible(lines)
}

write_result_readme()
```
